sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Committee Message Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of sync committee messages from production through aggregation to block inclusion

nodes.label: Validator Assigned to Sync Committee
nodes.description: Validator has been selected for a sync committee period, known ~256 epochs in advance

nodes.label: Join Sync Committee Subnet
nodes.description: Subscribe to the appropriate sync committee subnet with random offset 1-4 epochs before period end

nodes.label: Validator on Sync Committee Subnet
nodes.description: Validator is subscribed to the correct gossip subnet for sync committee duties

nodes.label: Produce SyncCommitteeMessage
nodes.description: Sign the beacon block root at ~1/3 through the slot and publish to the subnet

nodes.label: SyncCommitteeMessage Published
nodes.description: Individual sync committee signature has been published to the gossip subnet

nodes.label: Check Aggregator Eligibility
nodes.description: Determine if this validator is selected as an aggregator using is_sync_committee_aggregator (~16 per subcommittee)

nodes.label: Aggregate SyncCommitteeContributions
nodes.description: Collect and aggregate sync committee messages from the subnet into a SyncCommitteeContribution at ~2/3 through slot

nodes.label: SyncCommitteeContribution Published
nodes.description: Aggregated contribution published for block proposer to include

nodes.label: Block Proposer Collects Contributions
nodes.description: Block proposer selects best contribution per subnet (by signature count) and aggregates into SyncAggregate

nodes.label: SyncAggregate Included in Block
nodes.description: The SyncAggregate field is included in the proposed beacon block

edges.label: Slot arrives, produce message at 1/3 slot

external_entities.name: Beacon Chain
external_entities.description: The beacon chain providing sync committee assignments and slot timing

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Validator Slot Timing State Machine
sub_graphs.description: Models the critical timing boundaries within a slot for sync committee duties

nodes.label: Slot Begins
nodes.description: A new slot has started (t=0)

nodes.label: 1/3 Slot Mark Reached
nodes.description: One-third of the slot duration has elapsed - sync message deadline

nodes.label: Publish SyncCommitteeMessage
nodes.description: Validator must publish their sync committee message by the 1/3 slot deadline

nodes.label: 2/3 Slot Mark Reached
nodes.description: Two-thirds of the slot duration has elapsed - contribution deadline

nodes.label: Publish SyncCommitteeContribution
nodes.description: Aggregators must publish their contributions by the 2/3 slot deadline

nodes.label: Slot Ends
nodes.description: Slot is complete, next slot begins

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Committee Aggregator Selection
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic aggregator selection process and contribution verification

nodes.label: Validator in Active Sync Committee
nodes.description: Validator is a member of the current sync committee for this period

nodes.label: Compute Aggregator Selection Proof
nodes.description: Compute cryptographic proof using is_sync_committee_aggregator to determine if selected (~16 per subcommittee)

nodes.label: Selected as Aggregator
nodes.description: Validator is selected to aggregate sync committee messages for its subcommittee

nodes.label: Not Selected as Aggregator
nodes.description: Validator only produces individual sync messages, does not aggregate

nodes.label: Verify Block Root Match
nodes.description: Verify that collected sync messages reference beacon_block_root == block.parent_root for consistency

nodes.label: Select Best Contribution per Subnet
nodes.description: Among collected contributions, select the one with the highest signature count for each subnet

edges.label: Selection proof does not meet threshold

external_entities.name: Sync Committee Subnet Peers
external_entities.description: Other validators on the same sync committee subnet providing individual sync messages

ambiguities.text: The specification says validators get 'approximately 256 epochs of lookahead' for sync committee assignments, but the exact computation and edge cases are not detailed here.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the exact lookahead is EPOCHS_PER_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PERIOD (256) and validators learn their assignment at the start of the preceding period. Refer to the beacon chain spec for the exact computation.

ambiguities.text: The 'random offset of 1-4 epochs' for subnet joining before the sync committee period ends is described without specifying the randomness source.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the randomness is derived from the validator's private key and the period, providing deterministic but unpredictable jitter to avoid thundering herd on subnet joins.

implicit_assumptions.description: Validators are assumed to have sufficiently synchronized clocks to meet the 1/3 and 2/3 slot timing deadlines.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clock skew could cause validators to miss sync committee message deadlines, reducing participation rates and weakening light client security guarantees.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gossip network delivers sync committee messages to aggregators within the 1/3 to 2/3 slot window.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network delays could cause aggregators to miss individual messages, resulting in incomplete contributions and lower sync committee participation reflected on-chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot selectively delay or censor sync committee messages on specific subnets without controlling a significant portion of the gossip mesh.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted censorship of sync committee subnets could degrade light client security by reducing the number of signatures in SyncAggregates.
